text_block_list.text:
The year-end showdown. Taking on the Arima 
Kinen alongside Sakura Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Talk about a peach of a shock, cherry on 
top! To think I'd be taking on a 
long-distance race!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Trainer, did you already know?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Eh, so it's a miraculous coincidence? 
Whoa~... In that case, maybe I shouldn't 
say anything.
choice_data_list: Huh, you're not going to tell me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Just kidding, just kidding. I'll 
tell you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is one of the races 
Maruzen-san wasn't able to run in.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A certain article proclaimed: "There was 
an Umamusume there who could become 
Maruzen-san's fated rival."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Right now, Maruzen-san's rival is me. 
Isn't that right, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Let's show them just how strong our 
rivals are.

Yeah. Let's show them just how strong our 
rivals are!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After all, you showed us such a 
wonderful race that my heart felt ready to 
burst.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like it's you I need to settle 
things with, not Maruzen.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Because unlike an Umamusume who soars 
through the sky, I'm one who makes the 
earth tremble."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Freely, effortlessly. I'll challenge 
anyone who makes my heart race. Now then, 
shall we see what you've got?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! Bring it on! Looking forward to our 
match!
